name: Primal Darkness-II
english_description: A real, historically-operated (1999-2010) English-language Nightmare-mudlib-lineage MUD -- one of the largest libs onboarded this session at ~32,000 .c/.h files, pure ASCII (no encoding conversion needed). Rich, genuinely-authored domain tree (aekari, citrin, distopia, durst, forest, frozen, guilds, helgrath, helves, inferi_island, lodos, marshes, metaisland, pastarlon, roston, saahr, tirun, and more), a race-pick character-creation flow (30 playable races), and real historical player/wizard save data preserved from the archive. Two severe, corpus-wide programming bugs found and fixed during onboarding: (1) daemon/command.lpc's directory-scan command-dispatch table used stale ".c"-extension slice arithmetic (AGENTS.md #7.118), corrupting every single command verb's registered key so literally every command except quit returned the generic "What?" fail message for every player from the very first boot; (2) a from-scratch bug in the login object's restore-path privilege handoff (AGENTS.md #8.22, new): export_uid() silently no-ops unless the target's own euid is already unset, and even when it fires it only ever sets UID, never euid -- so an existing account's password check could never actually read its own save file, permanently blocking every RETURNING player (fresh registration was unaffected, which is why this was easy to miss). Also fixed: 8 base-class setter functions declared with narrower parameter types than 88% of the corpus's own call sites use, matching the established AGENTS.md #7.127 pattern (set_id/set_swarm/set_languages/set_alignment/set_long/set_short/set_door_func -- ~8,800 of ~10,000 original lpcc_check.sh failures); a genuinely lost/missing wizards/whit/keep/keep.h header reconstructed from surviving directory evidence; three instances of the #6.1 local-header-shadowed-by-global-header class (keep.h, drowpath.h, vplain.h); a 133-file inherit-after-global-variables ordering bug in an unreachable adm/save/boats.old/ backup directory. Full registration-to-gameplay playthrough (race pick, look/score/inventory/say/quit) AND the restore/reconnect path (a distinct code path, separately broken and separately fixed) verified live and repeatedly across multiple independent accounts; admin account (fluffos) seeded via the (superuser)/(assist)/(allowed)/(creator)/(approval)/(mudlib) groups.db groups plus a non-mortal position title, verified via a live update <path> compile+reload. A remaining ~2,300 lpcc_check.sh failures (mostly syntax errors, MudOS-only efuns, and a duplicate-function-declaration class) are concentrated almost entirely in explicitly-named backup/old/draft/wizard-scratch directories (guildbak/, /old/, wizards/*/builders/, cmds/oldskills/) confirmed unreachable from the live room network -- logged in NOTES.md, not fixed, per this project's content-vs-programming-bug scope line.
